OneDrive

OneDrive is Microsoft’s cloud storage solution enabling users to store, sync, and share files across devices, offering offline access, real-time collaboration, and enterprise-grade security

35 actionsSign in with OneDrive

Connect OneDrive

What your bot can do in OneDrive

Looks up

  • Get DriveRetrieves the properties and relationships of a drive resource by its unique id.
  • Get Drive QuotaRetrieve the quota information for the authenticated user's onedrive.
  • Get Item MetadataRetrieves the metadata of a driveitem by its unique id.
  • Get Item PermissionsRetrieves the permissions of a driveitem by its unique id or path within a specific drive.
  • Get Item ThumbnailsRetrieve the thumbnails associated with a driveitem.
  • Get Item VersionsRetrieve the version history of a driveitem by its unique id.
  • Get Recent ItemsRetrieves a list of items that have been recently used by the authenticated user.
  • Get Shared ItemsRetrieve a list of items that have been shared with the authenticated user.
  • Get SharePoint List ItemsGet the items (list items) within a specific sharepoint list on a site.
  • Get SharePoint Site Page ContentGets the content of a modern sharepoint site page.
Show 16 more
  • Get Site DetailsRetrieves metadata for a specific sharepoint site by its id.
  • List Drive Item ActivitiesList recent activities for a specific item in a onedrive drive.
  • List DrivesRetrieve a list of drive resources available to the authenticated user, or for a specific user, group, or site.
  • List Root Drive ChangesList changes in the root of the user's primary drive using a delta token.
  • List SharePoint List Items DeltaTrack changes to items in a sharepoint list using a delta query.
  • List Site ColumnsList all column definitions for a sharepoint site.
  • List Site Drive Items DeltaTrack changes to driveitems in the default document library of a sharepoint site.
  • List Site ListsList all lists under a specific sharepoint site.
  • List Site SubsitesList all subsites of a sharepoint site.
  • List SubscriptionsList the current subscriptions for the authenticated user or app.
  • Preview Drive ItemGenerates or retrieves a short-lived embeddable url for a preview of a specific item.
  • Search ItemsSearches for driveitems in onedrive that match the specified query.
  • Download a fileDownloads a file from a user's onedrive using its item id, which must refer to a file and not a folder.
  • Find FolderFinds folders by name within an accessible parent folder in onedrive, or lists all its direct child folders if no name is specified.
  • Find ItemNon-recursively finds an item (file or folder) in a specified onedrive folder.
  • List OneDrive itemsRetrieves all files and folders as driveitem resources from the root of a specified user's onedrive, automatically handling pagination.

Takes action

  • Copy ItemCopy a driveitem (file or folder) to a new location asynchronously.
  • Create Sharing LinkCreate a sharing link for a driveitem (file or folder) by its unique id.
  • Delete ItemDelete a driveitem (file or folder) by its unique id from the authenticated user's onedrive.
  • Invite User to Drive ItemInvite users or grant permissions to a specific item in a onedrive drive.
  • Move ItemMove a file or folder to a new parent folder in onedrive.
  • Update Drive Item MetadataUpdate the metadata of a specific item (file or folder) in onedrive.
